name: Fort Mill
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Fort Mill, SC 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Fort Mill, SC: Christmas Village and tree lighting, Christmas Parade, Miracle on Main Street, Cookie Crawl and Indian Land.
lede: Fort Mill celebrates Christmas with a town Christmas Village and tree lighting in Walter Elisha Park, a downtown parade and a string of Main Street events.
celebrates: The Town of Fort Mill lights a 50 foot Christmas tree at the Fort Mill Amphitheater in Walter Y. Elisha Park on Thursday, December 3, during its Christmas Village, which has trackless trains, kids' crafts and photos with Santa. The 79th Annual Fort Mill Christmas Parade follows on Saturday, December 5, in historic downtown. The same day brings Miracle on Main Street and the Kingsley Holiday Celebration, and the Fort Mill Cookie Crawl is on December 12. Just south, the Indian Land Christmas Parade moves to the CrossRidge Center on December 12.
lastyear: The Town of Fort Mill's parade page still shows its 78th Annual Fort Mill Christmas Parade from 2025, with a message honoring a retiring community leader who served on the Fort Mill Rotary Club, the Springs Close Foundation, the Boys and Girls Clubs of York County and Clemson University's Board of Visitors. The 2026 parade is the 79th, so the tradition is more than three quarters of a century old.
facts: Fort Mill's Christmas Village and tree lighting runs from 5 to 8 pm on December 3, with the lighting at 6 pm and snowfall from 5 to 7 pm. The Anne Springs Close Greenway also holds a Breakfast with Santa in some years, but its page shows only a 2019 date, so we do not list it. Indian Land's new CrossRidge Center will hold a brand new 50 foot Christmas tree for the parade day on December 12.
trains: Fort Mill has no Christmas train ride on our pages, but the Christmas Village on December 3 includes trackless trains and lighted Christmas trains for kids. For a real holiday train, our South Carolina and North Carolina Christmas train ride guides list options within a day trip, including the Polar Express at the N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer, north of Charlotte.
train_links: The museum in Spencer runs THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride in the Christmas season and is listed in our Charlotte guide.
traditions: A town evening at Walter Elisha Park with a 50 foot tree, trackless trains and Santa photos.

kidfact: Fort Mill's Christmas tree is 50 feet tall, and the Christmas Village has trackless trains.
faq: When is the Fort Mill tree lighting in 2026?

The Town of Fort Mill holds its Christmas Village and Lighting of the Tree on Thursday, December 3, 2026, from 5 to 8 pm at the Fort Mill Amphitheater in Walter Y. Elisha Park, 345 N. White Street. The tree lighting ceremony is at 6 pm and snowfall runs from 5 to 7 pm.
When is the Fort Mill Christmas Parade?

The 79th Annual Fort Mill Christmas Parade is on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 11 am in historic downtown Fort Mill. It is a public parade listed as free on this guide. See the Fort Mill event listing on this page for the host's details.
Is there a train for kids in Fort Mill?

The Christmas Village on December 3 offers trackless trains, according to the town's page and Visit York County's calendar. For a full size holiday train ride, the N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer runs the Polar Express, which is a long drive from Fort Mill.
What is happening in Indian Land?

The Indian Land Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting is on Saturday, December 12, 2026, at the CrossRidge Center, 3000 WorldReach Drive, with a Christmas Village at 10 am, the parade at 4 pm and the tree lighting at 5:30 pm. It is listed on this page.
Where can kids meet Santa in Fort Mill?

Santa is at the Christmas Village on December 3 for photos, according to Rally's listing of the town's event, and he appears at the Indian Land parade day on December 12. Check each event listing on this page for the host's details.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Fort Mill for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 3 (Fort Mill Christmas Village and Lighting of the Tree) through December 12 (Fort Mill Cookie Crawl and the Indian Land Christmas Parade), with the 79th Annual Fort Mill Christmas Parade (December 5), Miracle on Main Street (December 5) and the Kingsley Holiday Celebration (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Fort Mill
